text: {"lessons":["My account rose through Period 7 and then fell for three periods; that short run of random moves does not reveal what prices will do next.","Because I made no trades, I should not mistake the account’s gains or losses for evidence that inaction or any particular stock is the right choice; review my holdings against a clear plan.","I should not hold a position just to avoid admitting a mistake or sell solely because it is down; decide based on its role in my portfolio and my risk limits, not my average cost."]}
